name: Edge Case — Re-Apply from Preview Step
goal: Verify user can select 'Re-Apply' at preview step and restart application.
constraints: User reaches preview, selects 'Re-Apply', then starts new application.

phases.description: User completes application up to preview.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows preview with all details.

phases.description: User completes new application with different details.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows new preview with updated details.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
